messages:
morgan: heads up — onboarding sample app hitting schema validation in strict JSON mode when using the new TS helper. app works in python but JS fails on our function-call response schema :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
jia: ugh. can you paste the failing payload + a minimal repro?
morgan: here's the handler output from the sample app (trimmed):
```
{
  "name": "create_ticket",
  "arguments": {
    "title": "Missing seat",
    "metadata": null,
    "customer_id": undefined
  }
}
```
schema requires customer_id (string) and metadata (object). python SDK returns "customer_id": "123" and metadata: {}. TS helper drops keys with undefined which makes validation fail downstream.
trevor: interesting — we added stripUndefined=true in the TS helper to avoid sending unset keys to some endpoints. didn't realize function-calling needs explicit nulls for required fields.
jia: could auth/retry also surface here? if the call is retried after a token refresh, and the helper mutated the payload shape between attempts, we might observe different validation errors or duplicate function invocations. any logs showing duplicate fns?
morgan: saw two function-call entries in the app logs but only one in the model log. looks like the local helper retried a request after refresh and then re-sent without metadata. logs: "fncall:start -> fncall:ack -> fncall:start" for the same user action.
ben: thanks for pinging — I'm the TS SDK owner. this is a parity bug. JS helper defaulted to stripUndefined, py didn't. also the retry path reserialize using a cleaned object, so you can get inconsistent payloads across attempts. I'll push a patch to stop stripping undefined for function-call flows and make retry reuse the original serialized bytes.
jia: min fix: detect function_call mode and force full serialization (nulls kept). also add an opt-in config e.g., `preserveUndefinedForFnCall` so teams can opt-in until we flip default.
ben: yep. creating a tiny PR and a patch release. will add a unit test that simulates token refresh + retry to ensure no duplicate side effects.
ci-bot: deploy queued for v0.14.3-ts-sdk (contains patch for stripUndefined + retry serialization).
morgan: awesome — thanks. will re-run onboarding template after the release and report back. :thumbsup:
